grammar:
char ::= [^"\\\x00-\x1F] | [\\] (["\\bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F]{4})
response-format-schema ::= "{" space response-format-schema-reference-base-kv "," space response-format-schema-operation-kv "," space response-format-schema-target-kv "," space response-format-schema-objective-kv "," space response-format-schema-reason-kv "," space response-format-schema-preserve-kv ( "," space response-format-schema-denoise-kv )? space "}"
response-format-schema-denoise ::= ("0." [0-9]* [1-9] [0-9]* | "1" ("." "0"+)?)
response-format-schema-denoise-kv ::= "\"denoise\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-denoise
response-format-schema-objective ::= "\"" char{3,1200} "\""
response-format-schema-objective-kv ::= "\"objective\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-objective
response-format-schema-operation ::= ("\"keep\"" | "\"regenerate\"" | "\"handoff\"" | "\"sketch\"" | "\"local_edit\"" | "\"stop\"")
response-format-schema-operation-kv ::= "\"operation\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-operation
response-format-schema-preserve ::= "\"" char{0,1200} "\""
response-format-schema-preserve-kv ::= "\"preserve\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-preserve
response-format-schema-reason ::= "\"" char{3,1500} "\""
response-format-schema-reason-kv ::= "\"reason\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-reason
response-format-schema-reference-base ::= ("\"parent\"" | "\"child\"" | "\"neither\"")
response-format-schema-reference-base-kv ::= "\"reference_base\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-reference-base
response-format-schema-target ::= ("\"newbie\"" | "\"illustrious\"" | "\"anima\"" | "\"z_image_turbo\"")
response-format-schema-target-kv ::= "\"target\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-target
root ::= response-format-schema
space ::= [ \t\n\r]*

transformation.changed: Derive an independent text-only ReferenceNextChoice grammar; the old NextChoice schema and asset are unchanged
transformation.unchanged: Exact keys, required first six members, optional denoise, reference/operation/target enums, all string minima/maxima, numeric 0 < denoise <= 1 and host default 0.25
transformation.method: Deterministic preflight grammar for the exact frozen ReferenceNextChoice consumer; not a general JSON Schema converter
transformation.length_scope: All original text-choice bounds retained: objective 3..1200, reason 3..1500, preserve 0..1200. The complete schema and host validation remain authoritative; reject without truncation or repair.
transformation.numeric_scope: Sampler accepts JSON decimals without exponents, restricted to 0 < denoise <= 1; omitting denoise preserves the unchanged host default 0.25.
transformation.input_scope: Text-only reference and purpose-operation choice; no visual profile permission or resource-admission changes
transformation.reference_scope: The sampler preserves the parent/child/neither enum only. Host validation must check reference availability, actual source/condition bindings and that neither permits only regenerate or stop; syntax does not certify purpose, quality or user approval.
transformation.source_runtime_scope: Shared installed DLL diagnostic reference only, not a reference-choice response or failure receipt; no model weights are loaded by derivation.
